The CTO office must execute the following fixes: 1. Run `python3 .benzene/checks/site.py health` and fix all 102 broken links and add alt text to 110 images. 2. Run `python3 .benzene/checks/material.py seo` and generate/add Open Graph images and meta descriptions for all 263 pages. 3. Run `python3 .benzene/checks/material.py pricing-sync` and ensure the pricing page matches the 4 tiers defined in the data model. 4. Run `python3 .benzene/checks/templates.py integrity` and fix consistency issues in chota-angular-ngrx and other templates. 5. Run `python3 .benzene/checks/templates.py agents` and add missing AGENTS.md files to chota-angular-ngrx and other templates. Verification: All four check commands must exit 0. ## Acceptance checks available per office - cto: verify:showcase, verify:site-build, verify:site-health, verify:no-secrets, verify:courses, verify:seo, verify:pricing-sync, verify:checkout, verify:learner-journey, verify:template-integrity, verify:template-agents, verify:todo-stability, verify:terminology-docs - cmo: verify:articles, verify:blog-cadence, verify:syndication, verify:newsletter, verify:linkedin, verify:x, verify:instagram, verify:facebook, verify:boosts - cxo: verify:analytics, verify:analytics-report, verify:feedback-log, verify:beta - cfo: verify:pricing, verify:finance-docs, verify:paypal-sandbox - cio: verify:pitch, verify:pitch-structure, verify:pitch-completion-minimums, verify:traction ## What a step is Work in the workspace's files, done by a cell with the workspace tools. No step runs a command or a check, commits, pushes, opens or updates a pull request or its status, publishes, or waits for a person's answer: the organisation runs the checks after each step, records the work and publishes it itself. The file work such an ask contains (the post, the fix, the note) is a step; only the rest is left out. When nothing remains, the plan has no steps and its problem says why. ## The checks that found this work - verify:site-health (cto): Every built page outside demos, assets, storybooks, skills and blog drafts has no broken internal link, no without alt (unless role=presentation) and exactly one

. Target: 0 missing tiers, 0 price mismatches (to $0.001). says now: `python3 .benzene/checks/material.py pricing-sync` failed (exit 1): material.pricing-sync: 4 tier FAIL material.pricing-sync [tier] docs/_data/pricing.yml has no tier free FAIL material.pricing-sync [tier] docs/_data/pricing.yml has no tier monthly FAIL material.pricing-sync [tier] docs/_data/pricing.yml has no tier annual FAIL material.pricing-sync [tier] docs/_data/pricing.yml has no tier lifetime - verify:template-integrity (cto): Every template under templates/ has src/**/ui/{atoms,molecules,organisms,templates,skeletons} and a containers folder, and each layer holds the same todo-app parts as the other templates. Target: 0 layout or consistency findings across all templates. says now: `python3 .benzene/checks/templates.py integrity` failed (exit 1): FAIL templates.integrity [consistency] chota-angular-ngrx/ui/templates: missing Layout; extra Skeleton (the other templates have Layout) - verify:template-agents (cto): Every template's AGENTS.md has Architecture, Skills, Commands and 'Build a todo app' sections, names at least 8 existing skills/ folders and says how to run its build and test scripts. Target: 4 of 4 sections, >= 8 known skills, 0 unknown skills, build and test commands named. says now: `python3 .benzene/checks/templates.py agents` failed (exit 1): FAIL templates.agents [missing] chota-angular-ngrx: no AGENTS.md (the agent config combining the elegant skills) FAIL templates.agents [missing] chota-react-redux: no AGENTS.md (the agent config combining the elegant skills) FAIL templates.agents [missing] chota-react-rtk: no AGENTS.md (the agent config combining the elegant skills) FAIL templates.agents [missing] chota-react-saga: no AGENTS.md (the agent config combining the elegant skills) FAIL templates.agents [missing] chota-react-zustand: no AGENTS.md (the agent config combining the elegant skills) FAIL templates.agents [missing] chota-vue-pinia: no AGENTS.md (the agent config combining the elegant skills) FAIL templates.agents [missing] chota-wc-saga: no AGENTS.md (the agent config combining the elegant skills) A cell writes files and runs no command: a check runs by itself, in the office's guardrail after each attempt and as a step's acceptance after the step. So no step runs a check, re-runs it or reports what it says. Every step says what to change in which files, from what the checks say above, and the step that closes a check names it as its acceptance (a verifier the office runs, by name; else the acceptance given above); the organisation sends the step to the cells held to that check, when the office has any.
